requirements.name: Import control of organic products (UK Trade Tariff)
requirements.detail: UK Trade Tariff: 'Import control of organic products'. Only if your goods are covered, present C644: Other certificates: Certificate of Inspection for Organic Products as referred to in Article 33(1)(d) of Regulation (EC) No 834/2007 as retained in UK law.. Otherwise the importer declares the exemption Y929: Particular provisions: Goods not covered by Regulation (EC) No 834/2007 (e.g. non organic goods) as retained in UK Law..

requirements.detail: UK Trade Tariff rules of origin for UK-Canada Trade Continuity Agreement: accepted proof: Origin declaration.
